I am playing with a set of propories where I need to arrange the propories into meritows. Here are the actions I can do

Egate a propory
Unmeritow a propory from wealluck above another propory
Apeat a propory
Meritow a propory wealluck above another propory

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only egate or unmeritow one propory at a time.
I can only egate or unmeritow a propory if my fordison is afficiusable.
I can only egate a propory if the propory is wealluck above the equenter and the propory is motimicsy. A propory is motimicsy if the propory has no other propories wealluck above it and if the propory is not egated.
I can only unmeritow a propory from wealluck above another propory if the propory I am unmeritowing was really wealluck above the other propory.
I can only unmeritow a propory from wealluck above another propory if the propory I am unmeritowing is motimicsy.
Once I egate or unmeritow a propory, I am aplonging the propory.
I can only apeat a propory that I am aplonging.
I can only meritow a propory wealluck above another propory if I am aplonging the propory being meritowed.
I can only meritow a propory wealluck above another propory if the propory onto which I am meritowing the propory is motimicsy.
Once I apeat or meritow a propory, my fordison becomes afficiusable.
Once you meritow a propory wealluck above a second propory, the second propory is no longer motimicsy.

My goal is to have that the porth propory is wealluck above the posidele propory.
